summary: At segment 0 step 158, JavaScript refuses the Quest descent after the Master of Thieves dies. C mon.c:m_detach calls quest.c:leaddead for a dying MS_LEADER, setting killed_leader; JS only sets the separate leader_is_dead field and leaves killed_leader unset.

source.branch: In m_detach when due_to_death is true and mtmp->data->msound is MS_LEADER, C calls leaddead(), which sets quest_status.killed_leader. quest.c:ok_to_quest then allows descent independently of got_quest/got_thanks or purity. JS mondead() already sets leader_is_dead for the leader_m_id, but m_detach() records the missing leaddead call and JS ok_to_quest() reads killed_leader.
callers: The recorded hero kill follows mon.c xkilled() -> mondead() -> m_detach(); JavaScript mon.js xkilled() -> mondead() -> m_detach() awaits each stage.
The subsequent do.c goto_level() calls ok_to_quest() before rejecting descent from the Quest start level; JavaScript do.js uses quest.js ok_to_quest() at the corresponding guard.

requiredFunctions.name: leaddead
requiredFunctions.reason: The source call mutates killed_leader; that field is the permission condition read by quest.c:ok_to_quest().

evidence: The admitted v65 evaluation at 979a3f3967638748dc19cf8b6ea8851736ade63e records this case at 158/182 screens, 3996/6697 RNG calls and 165/182 cursors. The admitted manifest identifies step 158 as the first mismatch.

A fresh scan at bccd8eb5623756f1c0d95a007a179fa46200fb93 reproduced screen mismatch at segment 0 step 158 (C 'Y', JavaScript 'A'), RNG mismatch at index 3996 (C rn2(3)=2 in bones.c:getbones, JS rn2(19)=12), and cursor mismatch at step 158. The scan recorded 'mon.c the quest leader's death' as unported.

Upstream mon.c:2734-2803 calls leaddead() inside m_detach() only under due_to_death and MS_LEADER, before dropping the monster inventory. Upstream quest.c:116-122 sets killed_leader once; quest.c:139-144 reads that field in ok_to_quest().

JavaScript mon.js:4772-4890 records the missing m_detach branch through unsupported("the quest leader's death"). JavaScript mon.js mondead() already sets the separate leader_is_dead field, while quest.js:209-216 checks killed_leader. The recorded RNG mismatch occurs downstream when the newly permitted descent enters Home 2 generation.

firstMismatch.message: C calls quest.c:leaddead() for the dying quest leader and permits the descent; JavaScript leaves quest_status.killed_leader unset.

selectionRationale: The v65 manifest attributes the step-158 mismatch to the omitted leaddead state transition. The same leader-death branch and later level-permission consumer are independent of the currently reserved m_detach-adjacent source scopes.

overlapCrosswalk.scope: The saved admitted queue and prior quest findings.
overlapCrosswalk.causalDifference: The earlier v44 case observes the leader-death pager path but does not continue to the quest-level descent guard. This v65 case distinguishes leader_is_dead from killed_leader by consuming killed_leader through ok_to_quest().
overlapCrosswalk.withinBatch: The selected case is the only v65 candidate with this first source behavior.
